surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the adsorption of TMA and NH3 plasma on the Si(111) surface, followed by surface reactions that form AlN. The plasma enhances the reactivity of the precursors, allowing the reactions to proceed at lower temperatures. The mechanism is described as involving ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups, followed by a water pulse to regenerate OH sites.
